thread:
support-jen: p0 - customer ACME reported mass 504s / timeouts from hosted API around 09:45 UTC. They say calls to /v1/generate are timing out. Seeing lots of queued requests in the router and scale-up backlog. Can we triage? :eyes:

arnold-sre: looking... I see a sudden jump in scaleup latency for tenant-44. HPA didn't create pods because the ScaledObject metrics weren't matching the annotation keys. KEDA logs show 'no matching scaler' for the metric name.

maria: are we sure it's KEDA vs HPA interop? Could be the recent k8s patch changed annotation parsing. I pushed a small probe yesterday to reduce prewarm TTL, maybe mismatch.

infra-simone: quick snapshot from keda-controller: "ScaledObject tenant-44: metrics=[qps0] annotations={'redwood.com/prewarm-ttl':'60s'}" but our scaler expects 'redwood.com/prewarm-ttl-seconds'. So the scaler ignores the config and falls back -> cold start.

dan: confirmed from router logs: many requests hit model backend and got 504 from gateway after 30s timeout. Example logs: ```HTTP 504 GET /v1/generate tenant=tenant-44 route=chat model=redwood-13b latency=30012ms```. Also see readiness failing: pod init waiting on model fetch then killed because probe never passed.

support-jen: customer provided repro: repeated concurrent requests at t=09:44-09:46. They attached curl script. Sharing minimal repro snippet: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate & done``` They said some complete, many 504s.

arnold-sre: hypothesis: annotation name drift + prewarm TTL mismatch -> KEDA doesn't schedule prewarm pods -> when burst hits, controllers try to scale but model init + kv cache warmup takes > probe timeout -> readiness never true -> gateway times out.

maria: can we check recent deploys? I rolled the prewarm TTL change to staging then accidentally merged to main. Rollout window shows config drift at 2026-03-16 23:10 UTC.

infra-simone: current quick mitigations: 1) patch ScaledObject to add the legacy annotation name expected by scaler, 2) increase readiness/liveness probe timeout for model init + bump prewarm TTL to 300s for tenant-44, 3) temporarily lower router gateway timeout to 45s? (may mask but reduces 504s).

dan: I'll open a hotfix PR to add the fallback annotation mapping in keda scaler code and backfill the scaledobject for impacted tenants. Also will add alignment test in infra CI.

billing-oliver: FYI some customers reported billing spikes because of retries. We should coordinate any billing credits; I'll flag impacted tenants and start temporary credits.

support-jen: Customer-facing response drafted: "We're investigating an autoscale regression affecting a subset of tenants causing delayed scale-up and gateway timeouts. We're applying a hotfix and will follow up with a timeline and credits." Can we escalate ETA? :+1:

arnold-sre: ETA for PR -> 15m to merge + rollout to controllers -> 10m, then backfill scaledobjects script -> 5m. Full validation 30m. So ~1hr to be safe.

ops-bot: deploy started: keda-controller v2.8.11-hotfix -> rollout 3/3 pods updated.

maria: after hotfix, observed scaledobject create events and immediate scaling attempts. However model pods still show long model-fetch times (S3 TTL + cold cache). I recommend enabling prefix KV cache warming on prewarm path.

dan: added backfill script and ran for tenant-44, scaledobject annotations patched. New pods created and passed readiness after ~42s due to model init. Router logs show reduced 504s. Sample: ```HTTP 200 POST /v1/generate tenant=tenant-44 latency=512ms```.

support-jen: customer confirmed degraded but improving, some calls still slow but no longer mass 504s. They asked for postmortem and timeline.

arnold-sre: follow-ups: 1) revert the accidental annotation key change and add strict CI lint for ScaledObject annotations, 2) add end-to-end smoke test for prewarm TTL and KEDA mapping, 3) add metric alert for "scaledobject-mismatch" when scaler returns no-match, 4) consider increasing default probe timeout for model pods for first 2 minutes of init.

maria: I'll own the postmortem draft. Dan please add PR links and logs. Simone please capture rollback and backfill commands we ran.

support-jen: thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and attach this thread to the ticket. :raised_hands:

arnold-sre: closing notes: root cause = config key drift (annotation rename) + insufficient prewarm TTL + probe timeouts -> combined to block prewarm scaling and cause scale-up lag -> gateway 504s. Remediation: hotfix + backfill + CI + smoke tests + billing credits.

support-jen: noted. marking incident P1 -> follow-up postmortem required.
summary: Autoscale failure for tenant-44 caused by annotation key drift plus short prewarm TTL and probe timeouts leading to delayed pod readiness and customer 504s. Hotfix and backfill applied; customer improving.
